proposals.before: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai, Lu Wenji, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly with the Secretariat Under the Gate Pallarak Grand Councillor.
proposals.after: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai, Lu Wenji, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.
proposals.reason: “Pallarak Grand Councillor” is a corrupted rendering of 同中書門下平章事; restore the standard office translation.

proposals.after: In the eighth month, on xinwei, Yao Ting, Left Vice Director of the Ministries, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.
proposals.reason: Same corrupted “Pallarak” rendering of 同中書門下平章事 as elsewhere in the chapter.

proposals.before: In the third month, on bingwu, Ma Yinsun, Hanlin academician and Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly with the Secretariat Under the Gate Pallarak Grand Councillor.
proposals.after: In the third month, on bingwu, Ma Yinsun, Hanlin academician and Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.

proposals.before: Li Congke, Prince of Lu and military governor of Fengxiang, rose in rebellion.
proposals.after: Congke, Prince of Lu and military governor of Fengxiang, rebelled.
proposals.reason: Chinese has 從珂 without the surname Li; the idiomatic line invents “Li Congke” here, though the identification is otherwise correct. Prefer the form matching the source surface.

decisions.reason: Focus unit has 同中書門下平章事; “Pallarak Grand Councillor” is a corrupt non-word rendering of that office. The proposed “joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery” restores the standard sense while keeping the rest of the literal appointment wording.
Same corrupt “Pallarak” rendering of 同中書門下平章事 in the Yao Ting appointment; the proposed office phrase matches the Chinese and leaves the surrounding literal intact.

Zhang Yanlang’s appointment likewise ends in 同中書門下平章事; replacing the garbled “Pallarak Grand Councillor” with “joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery” corrects the office without changing agents or dates.
Ma Yinsun’s line has the same 同中書門下平章事 title; the before text’s “Pallarak” is not a real reading, and the proposed literal restores the standard Secretariat-Chancellery office translation.

Focus unit names 潞王從珂 with no surname 李; idiomatic “Li Congke” invents a personal name absent from the Chinese. Restoring Congke (as the literal already has) matches the source surface while keeping title, office, and rebellion intact.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 鳳翔節度使潞王從珂反

claimRetractions.reason: Accepting r0005 shows s0011 only has 從珂, not 李從珂; the full personal-name “Li Congke” was created by the invented surname in the bad idiomatic. The given-name Congke is already claimed in c0088.
